messages:
Sonia Mehta: Quick heads-up 1 NorthBridge driver (marketplace:northbridge/nic:v2.1) prompts an interactive EULA during install. AcmeRetail private deploy (air-gapped) fails because no tty. Need legal + short-term plan.
Marco Ruiz: Confirmed. We pushed v2.1 last week. Hosted installs auto-accept via relay, but private customers hit the prompt.
Mari Gomez: Legal here 1 we can't pre-accept EULAs for third-party vendors without explicit redistribution consent. Need vendor legal contact and a signed addendum.
Priya Singh: AcmeRetail is on a tight go-live and we have a joint announcement scheduled. Partner asked if we can ship a short mitigation to avoid delaying the announcement.
Sonia Mehta: Options: (1) promote legacy driver v2.0 for that tenant (if vendor allows redistribution) (2) vendor provides written pre-acceptance for us to publish a tenant-pinned image (3) postpone announcement. Which is fastest?
Marco Ruiz: Technically we can pin v2.0 and publish a tenant-specific image quickly, but legal still needs vendor sign-off.
Mari Gomez: I'll reach vendor legal now. If they agree, estimate 48-72h to get an addendum signed. If they refuse, we'll need to delay or switch to an OSS driver alternative.
eng-oncall-bot: Created ticket PART-9001 and scheduled emergency arch review 2026-03-23 08:00 PST.
Priya Singh: I'll draft a short customer-facing hold notice for AcmeRetail and share it with CSM by EOD.
Sonia Mehta: Please also add a marketplace onboarding checkbox for "interactive installers / EULA redistrib" so SI teams are warned.
Marco Ruiz: Will update PART-9001 with a technical checklist and standby the promote command if legal signs off.
Mari Gomez: Updating vendor outreach. Will post back here when I have a response.
Sonia Mehta: Thanks all 1 reconvene in arch review.
